However, the diagnostic value of the theta/beta ratio has proven inconsistent across cohorts, which limits its use as a clinical marker \cite{arns2013}. However, deep networks remain large relative to cohorts of tens of participants, which favors overfitting. Moreover, their latent features resist neurophysiological reading, which indicates that attribution is unfaithful. Moreover, leakage across windows of one child inflates the reported accuracy. In this context, a compact learner plays a crucial role in clinical neuroimaging.

However, the single shot angle arm reached a balanced accuracy of 0.71 because the frontal channels carry the class signal, and because the windows of one child share the label. The single shot angle arm was trained end to end, because the front end is differentiable. This highlights that the single shot angle arm serves as a lower bound. Overall, the single shot angle arm delivers the frequency it promises where the frequency is known to matter.

Notably, the hybrid model was compared against the single shot angle arm under the same folds. Notably, label noise lowered accuracy less in the fixed regime, where the slope reached a smaller magnitude. Overall, the single shot angle arm delivered the expressivity it promises where that expressivity is known to matter. Taken together, the hybrid model earned no measurable gain on the clinical data, which suggests that capacity is not the bottleneck.
